verdict: Leads stalled and Google Ads spent $2,039 with zero results this period.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, all 30 leads came from Meta at a cost of $125.10 per lead — Google Ads generated zero conversions on $2,038.69 in spend, and that imbalance drove cost per lead up 102% week-over-week. Lead volume also fell sharply in the most recent 7 days, with spend holding steady, meaning this is a results problem, not a budget problem. Google Ads targeting and conversion tracking are under immediate review, and Meta creative is being refreshed to stabilize lead flow. Six project milestones — including site launch, ads launch, and retargeting — remain incomplete from their July–August target dates, and closing those is the priority that unlocks the rest of the program. Expect a clearer picture on Google performance once tracking is confirmed and the overdue deliverables are resolved.
